commands.start_desc:
Welcome to the Bandori Bot! Use /help to view the help message. 

If the current language is not your preferred language, use /lang to set your preferred language.
commands.help_desc:
Available commands:
/start - Start the bot and get a welcome message.
/help - Show this help message.
/lang - Set the language.
/cards <card_id> - Query information about a specific card by its ID.
/cards <card_id> <region> - Query information about a specific card by its ID and server code.
/events - Query ongoing events.
/events <event_id> - Query information about a specific event by its ID.
/events <event_id> <region> - Query information about a specific event by its ID and server code.
/cutoff <event_id> - Query the predicted cutoff for a specific event by its ID.
/cutoff <event_id> <tier> <region> - Query the predicted cutoff for a specific event by its ID, tier, and server code.
/song <song_name> - Query information about a specific song by its name.
/search <keyword> - Search for songs by keyword.
/song <song_name> - Query information about a specific song by its name.
/gacha - Query ongoing gacha.
/gacha <gacha_id> - Query information about a specific gacha by its ID.
commands.lang_desc: Select the language you want to set.
commands.lang_desc_group: Please use the /lang command in a private chat to set the language.
commands.dlanguages_desc:
Set the display language.
This setting only affects the text displayed by the bot, not the information queried from the cards.
commands.qlanguages_desc:
Set the query language.
This setting only affects the information queried from the cards, not the text displayed by the bot.
